items.action: Confirm legal entity, workforce roster, control owners, and production-access population.
items.exitEvidence: Approved soc2-program record, organization roster, and access population.

items.action: Approve the policy set, risk register, and assigned control responsibilities without backdating.
items.exitEvidence: Signed policy-approval record and risk approvals.

items.action: Export all in-scope accounts, enforce MFA, remove shared/stale access, document least privilege, and approve the review.
items.exitEvidence: Completed access-review record plus source exports/screenshots.

items.action: Execute confidentiality/IP terms, complete security training, and adopt onboarding/offboarding checklists for the full population.
items.exitEvidence: Signed terms, training completion, and lifecycle records in the restricted audit room.

items.action: Connect and monitor identity, GitHub, Vercel, Convex, storage, email, and application security events with an escalation route.
items.exitEvidence: Logging inventory, alert rules, retention configuration, alert test, and responder acknowledgement.

items.action: Commission an independent authenticated penetration test and close or formally accept all material findings.
items.exitEvidence: Final report, remediation tickets, and retest letter under NDA.

items.action: Complete assessments for every enabled vendor and retain contracts, DPAs, assurance reports, regions, retention, and recovery terms.
items.exitEvidence: One approved vendor-assessment record and evidence set per vendor.

items.action: Run and document a security incident tabletop covering cross-tenant access and external model disclosure.
items.exitEvidence: Completed tabletop record, attendance, lessons, corrective actions, and approvals.

items.action: Run and document a representative metadata/private-object recovery exercise and measure RTO/RPO.
items.exitEvidence: Completed recovery-exercise record with integrity and owner-isolation validation.

items.action: Approve retention periods and perform an end-to-end deletion test including documented vendor backup lifecycle.
items.exitEvidence: Approved schedule, deletion test, exceptions, and backup-expiry evidence.

items.action: Enable protected main/production release approvals, secret protection, dependency features, and retain deployed commit evidence.
items.exitEvidence: Repository/deployment settings export and successful controlled release.

items.action: Conduct the first management control review and track every exception to closure.
items.exitEvidence: Completed quarterly-review record and corrective-action log.

items.action: Select the independent CPA auditor, confirm Security + Confidentiality scope, and agree the Type I as-of date.
items.exitEvidence: Signed engagement letter and auditor-confirmed scope/date.
